fieldHints.Array sends each item to the next module: Array sends each item to the next module separately (like an Iterator).
fieldHints.The module whose items are merged Usuall: The module whose items are merged. Usually the Iterator right before this module.
fieldHints.The run continues as if the module had r: The run continues as if the module had returned this value.
fieldHints.Dry-run first Reports what WOULD change: Dry-run first. Reports what WOULD change without writing anything.
fieldHints.Each line or comma-separated value is tr: Each line or comma-separated value is treated as a separate shift ID.
fieldHints.How many times the following modules run: How many times the following modules run.
fieldHints.Choose or create the inbound webhook tha: Choose or create the inbound webhook that starts this workflow.
fieldHints.How much the counter increments per repe: How much the counter increments per repeat.
fieldHints.Paste a JSON array or object here The ne: Paste a JSON array or object here. The next module receives it as input.
fieldHints.Select a specific element from the HTML: Select a specific element from the HTML.
fieldHints.Start value of the counter ({{i}}) on th: Start value of the counter ({{i}}) on the first repeat.
fieldHints.Fields collected per item into the outpu: Fields collected per item into the output array.
fieldHints.Requires \"store incomplete runs\" to be: Requires "store incomplete runs" to be enabled in the workflow settings.
fieldHints.Which field from the previous module hol: Which field from the previous module holds the array to iterate over.
fieldHints.Which field is used as the identifier in: Which field is used as the identifier in the next module.
fieldHints.Sla kandidaten over die al coördinaten h: Skip candidates that already have coordinates. Recommended for bulk.
fieldHints.Empty = all statuses (blacklist is alway: Empty = all statuses (blacklist is always excluded).
fieldHints.Eg only temp workers or freelancers Empt: E.g. only temp workers or freelancers. Empty = all contract forms.
fieldHints.Only relevant when the linked entity is: Only relevant when the linked entity is a customer.
fieldHints.Skip records that already have a link wi: Skip records that already have a link with this system. Recommended for bulk.
fieldHints.Empty = no contact filter (all candidate: Empty = no contact filter (all candidates are included).
fieldHints.{{kandidaatid}} = draait per kandidaat u: {{kandidaat.id}} = runs per candidate from the previous step (bulk; empty works too). For a single candidate: {{trigger.candidate_id}} (drill-down button or address change).
fieldHints.{{recordid}} = runs per record (of the c: {{record.id}} = runs per record (of the chosen type) from the previous step (bulk; empty works too). For a single record: {{trigger.<type>_id}} (drill-down button or address change).
fieldHints.Supports {maand} for the current month n: Supports {maand} for the current month name.
fieldHints.De tenant-instelling webhook_endpoint_<s: The tenant setting webhook_endpoint_<slug> determines the URL.
fieldHints.Text that is stamped on the candidate an: Text that is stamped on the candidate and in the audit trail.
fieldHints.The workflow started as a child (async,: The workflow started as a child (async, via the queue). Self-calls and cycles are refused; maximum 5 levels deep.
fieldHints.Dry-run first reports WHO would be creat: Dry-run first: reports WHO would be created (incl. payload), writes nothing. Turn off explicitly to really create in Shiftmanager.
fieldHints.The conditions always follow the vacancy: The conditions always follow the vacancy's own match criteria: to change them, change the match criteria or the weighting templates. This step only picks the set.
fieldHints.Date and time (eg 10-08-2026 1400) or a: Date and time (e.g. 10-08-2026 14:00) or a variable.
fieldHints.Idempotency the same template is not sen: Idempotency: the same template is not sent to the same candidate again within this window (0 = always send).
fieldHints.Optional Eg whatsapp_consent skip this e: Optional. E.g. whatsapp_consent: skip this e-mail when the candidate has that field set to true (prevents a double send alongside a WhatsApp step).
fieldHints.Optional Set a role name (eg backoffice): Optional. Set a role name (e.g. backoffice) to send this step to everyone with that role instead of the candidate bundle.
fieldHints.Optional Eg \"conversation\" the notific: Optional. E.g. "conversation": the notification then links to the matching "conversation_id" field from the trigger, so it becomes clickable.
fieldHints.candidate = candidate, customer = custom: candidate = candidate, customer = customer, customer_location = customer location, vacancy = vacancy.
fieldHints.Selects every customer / customer locati: Selects every customer / customer location / vacancy (max. 10,000, archived excluded). Does not work for candidates: use the "Fetch candidates" step for those.
fieldHints.Added to the days (eg 1 day + 3 hours): Added to the days (e.g. 1 day + 3 hours).
fieldHints.If the moment falls on a weekend, it mov: If the moment falls on a weekend, it moves to Monday at the same time.
fieldHints.The full, tenant-editable instruction fo: The full, tenant-editable instruction for the AI agent: persona, step state machine, hard rules. The runtime response contract is added automatically.
fieldHints.If the candidate doesn't reply, the run: If the candidate doesn't reply, the run falls back after this many hours (workflows:resume-due watchdog).
fieldHints.Only connected WhatsApp Web numbers (per: Only connected WhatsApp Web numbers (personal or branch).
fieldHints.Leaving this empty means automatic first: Leaving this empty means automatic: first the branch, otherwise the default.
fieldHints.Via WhatsApp Web only a session message: Via WhatsApp Web only a session message (free text) can be sent.
fieldHints.Lets the AI agent consult the FAQ during: Lets the AI agent consult the FAQ during the conversation.
fieldHints.The numbered steps the AI agent walks th: The numbered steps the AI agent walks through, each with an optional output field and variable chips.
fieldHints.Extra persona- en toonaanwijzingen voor: Extra persona and tone guidance for the AI agent, alongside the instructions above. The runtime reply contract is added automatically.
fieldHints.Volgt standaard de tenant-instelling; de: Follows the tenant setting by default; this vacancy can override it here.
fieldHints.Verplicht als de gekozen agent geen intr: Required if the chosen agent has no intro template; a fresh applicant sits outside the 24-hour window, so a session text as intro fails.
fieldHints.queue (default) = queue, this step doesn: queue (default) = queue, this step doesn't wait. sync = run directly; the child's outcome comes back into this step.
fieldHints.Only for direct execution a failed child: Only for direct execution: a failed child workflow fails this step. Off = continue; the outcome is in child_run_status.
fieldHints.On by default this step's candidates/rec: On by default: this step's candidates/records travel along as the child's context.
fieldHints.Extra key/value pairs for the child ({{t: Extra key/value pairs for the child ({{trigger.*}} is already resolved here).
fieldHints.Only for Unavailable, Sick and Leave: Only for Unavailable, Sick and Leave.
fieldHints.Always make a new AI call, even if there: Always make a new AI call, even if there is recent advice
fieldHints.Advice younger than this many hours is s: Advice younger than this many hours is skipped unless "Always refresh" is on.
fieldHints.Hard ceiling on the number of records th: Hard ceiling on the number of records this step advises in one run ("List (bulk)" mode).
fieldHints.\"Single record\" = the trigger/manual r: "Single record" = the trigger/manual record; "List (bulk)" = every row from the previous fetch step.
fieldHints.Relative window measured from today, neg: Relative window measured from today, negative means back in time. Only used when no dates are filled in.
fieldHints.Relative window measured from today Only: Relative window measured from today. Only used when no dates are filled in.
fieldHints.Factors left empty use the default point: Factors left empty use the default points.
fieldHints.Bonus or malus per customer id, for exam: Bonus or malus per customer id, for example 2 or -3.
fieldHints.Per function the primary and secondary f: Per function the primary and secondary function names that count as a match, in lower case.
fieldHints.Lets the AI agent consult the tenant's d: Lets the AI agent consult the tenant's documents/knowledge base during the conversation. Only works when the agent itself has knowledge available.
fieldHints.Skip records that already carry coordina: Skip records that already carry coordinates; recommended for bulk runs.
fieldHints.Direct https URL for this step Leave bla: Direct https URL for this step. Leave blank to use the shared setting webhook_endpoint_<slug> below. No credentials in the URL.
fieldHints.Only used if no URL is set above the ten: Only used if no URL is set above: the tenant setting webhook_endpoint_<slug> then determines the URL.
fieldHints.A field name of the source record (mobil: A field name of the source record (mobile, phone, …), never a phone number. Manual sending happens from the record itself.
fieldHints.Dit lijkt een telefoonnummer Vul de veld: This looks like a phone number. Enter the source record’s field name, e.g. mobile.
